messages:
Maya Chen: Alert: HeliosPay daily API traffic down ~72% over 7d. Renewal in ~6 weeks. Procurement contact switched last week to Lina Ortega. @Ravi please pull 30d token/request metrics.
Ravi Singh: Pulling now. checking whether this is seat churn vs integration drop.
Maya Chen: Onboarding completed in Jan but usage never expanded past payments team. Customer PM said exec roadmap reprioritized and they're re-evaluating vendors (called out "NimbusAI").
Jordan Lee: Sounds like a competitive test. I'll ask Lina for a 15-min sync to understand evaluation criteria.
Priya Nair: Billing oddity: finance shows a shared mailbox as pay contact. @finance-bot status?
finance-bot: Invoice: 1 unpaid (30d past). Last payment 2025-11-02. Billing contact billing@heliospay.com updated 2026-02-10.
Maya Chen: Unpaid invoice + procurement change ups risk. Proposed triage: 1) short health check + targeted enablement 2) exec QBR with new procurement + finance 3) propose 4-week pilot or throughput credit to match competitor pricing.
Ravi Singh: Metrics snapshot uploaded: https://redwood.internal/exports/heliospay-30d-1763349999.csv
Jordan Lee: Reached out to Lina, pinged for 15 min slot. Will update outcome here.
Maya Chen: Action owners/dates: Jordan (outreach + competitor intel) due 2026-03-18; Ravi (metrics + error check) due 2026-03-16; Priya (billing + renewal timeline) due 2026-03-16; Evan to draft 30-min enablement + cost/latency one-pager due 2026-03-17; Maya to schedule QBR for w/c 2026-03-23. React with :thumbsup: to claim.
Priya Nair: Ill coordinate with finance to unfreeze invoice and attach org chart.
account-bot: Tentative QBR created 2026-03-24 16:00 PDT, invites pending.
Maya Chen: Let's aim to convert this into a short POC rather than letting evaluation drift. Update after Jordan's sync. :rocket:
